port_test.configuration: Standalone N=8, independent of the requester counts in the CPU.
port_test.comparison: 261 public-port expectations: all 256 request vectors with ready_i=1, then a held request with newly asserted higher-priority requesters, acceptance, and the next selection. No internal signals are compared.
port_test.environment: Verilator 5.008 with --binary --timing --assert, a C++ toolchain and make; VERILATOR may name its executable. CVA6_REPO must contain the recorded HPDcache Git objects. The dependency encoder is read from f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03.
port_test.result: Success requires process exit 0, SUMMARY checks=261 errors=0 and FXARB_PORT_TEST_COMPLETE, then continues to the CPU evaluator. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2).
